title: Lior and the Aftermath
author: B. M. Reyes
blurb: Marguerite Eastwick, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the demolition date arrives.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
